Birdies Indoor Golf and Cocktail Bar Long Island
description: An indoor golf simulator center with a cocktail and sports bar and an outdoor beer garden on North Ocean Avenue in Patchogue. Local bands play on Friday nights, and DJs run dance parties on Saturday nights.

dancing.notes: Birdies is a big space (two floors plus a beer garden) but has no dedicated dance floor that we could confirm. Fridays have live bands at 8 PM followed by DJs, and Saturdays are promoted as DJ dance parties from 10 PM. Some band nights are mellow acoustic sets, so dancing depends on the act.

evidence.note: Official specials page: live music every Friday at 8 PM with DJs at 10 PM, and a Saturday DJ dance party from 10 PM to 2 AM.
Official About page: about 11,000 square feet with golf simulators, a sports bar, a restaurant area and an outdoor beer garden.
